steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hahaha... Thank you, my Legion friends. It feels so good to be free! We can eliminate them in no time. Revenge time. Charge! Let's go, Hecate!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: <size=30><color=#7683a2>This is an order. This is an order...</size> </color>

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Just as I expected, these monsters can not be trusted. Shouldn't have included them in the combat troops in the first place.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: What do we do now? They have the Chief. Our hands are tied. Should we let them pass?
No. If we do let them pass, the Chief will be in real danger.

A soldier in heavy armor arrives at the scene. His strides are firm and steady, and he is holding a heavy ax. The number 036 is painted on his armor, a clear indication that he is different from the other soldiers.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: The other soldiers are no longer confused...

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Careful... That man has boosted the morale of the troops with just a few words. He's no ordinary soldier.
I'll take command. We'll get him back here and now.
steps.female_content: I'll take command. We'll get her back here and now.
